howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能解释 Codex Rules 的自动注入机制：在会话开始和用户提交时注入静态项目规则，在 apply_patch 后注入匹配文件规则，并注入 PostToolUse 动态上下文；也会说明支持的规则文件位置和环境变量配置。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 的行为、规则文件位置或环境配置等相关问题时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件位置？
say.note: Claude 会列出所有支持的项目来源。

say.text: 动态规则在什么时候注入？
say.note: Claude 会说明是在 apply_patch 之后。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude explains Codex Rules' auto-injection: static project rules on SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit, file-specific rules after apply_patch, and PostToolUse dynamic context; also covers supported rule file locations and env config.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, rule file locations, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: What rule file locations does Codex Rules support?
say_en.note: Claude lists the supported project sources.
Claude explains the environment variable options.
Claude says it happens after apply_patch.
